core: Restraint of interleukin and TNF production
qualifier: including IL-10 and IL-12, in T cell responses
name: Restraint of interleukin and TNF production, including IL-10 and IL-12
rationale: Most members negatively regulate production of IL-2, IL-6, IL-10, IL-12, IL-21 and TNF or Th1/Treg responses; the IL-12 and IL-10 production terms separate it from the T cell-suppression confusable, and the T cell/IL-2/IL-21 terms from the inflammatory-cytokine one.

qualifier: heavy metals, pesticides and dioxin
name: Response to heavy metals, pesticides and dioxin
rationale: All members are responses to lead, cobalt, mercury, herbicide, insecticide or dioxin (via aryl hydrocarbon receptor); the heavy metal ions separate it from the drug/xenobiotic confusables and the pesticides/dioxin from the iron/selenium-HMOX1 confusable.

qualifier: via protoporphyrinogen, with its regulation
name: Heme B biosynthesis via protoporphyrinogen and its regulation
rationale: Members cover heme B and protoporphyrinogen IX synthesis, mitochondrial heme-related ABC transport and regulation of tetrapyrrole and hemoglobin synthesis; this separates it from heme uptake/iron handling, iron-sulfur cluster assembly and heme A synthesis confusables.

qualifier: keratinocyte cornification plus melanocyte MITF-driven pigmentation
name: Keratinocyte cornification and melanocyte MITF-driven pigmentation
rationale: Members span keratinocyte differentiation, cornified envelope and skin barrier formation together with MITF-M-regulated melanocyte and melanin programmes; the MITF/melanin arm distinguishes it from the ectodermal appendage confusables and the keratinocyte arm from the pigment granule confusable.

core: Hormonal control of hepatic glucose metabolism
qualifier: glucagon-PKA, glycogen turnover and fructose 2,6-bisphosphate
name: Glucagon-PKA regulation of glycogen turnover and glycolytic flux
rationale: Members concern glucagon/PKA signalling, regulation of glycogen synthesis and breakdown, glucokinase and fructose 2,6-bisphosphate control of glycolysis; glucagon/PKA and regulatory terms distinguish it from glycogen storage disease/glycolysis and insulin-signalling confusables.

qualifier: FSH/LH secretion, Sertoli and follicle development
name: Gonadotropin secretion and FSH-driven gonadal development
rationale: Members cover FSH/LH secretion and its regulation, response to FSH, and Sertoli cell, seminiferous tubule, germ cell and ovarian follicle development; it lacks the activin/AMH signalling and Leydig/meiosis terms of the confusables and adds gonadotropin secretion control.

qualifier: in antibody-driven hypersensitivity and cytotoxicity
name: Complement activation and regulation in antibody-driven hypersensitivity
rationale: Members are classical, lectin, alternative and terminal complement activation and their regulation plus antibody-dependent cytotoxicity and type II/IV hypersensitivity; the complement core separates it from Fc receptor/myeloid confusables, and the hypersensitivity/ADCC terms from the antimicrobial confusable.

core: Hormonal control of hepatic glycogen turnover
qualifier: glucagon-PKA and glucokinase
name: Glucagon-PKA and glucokinase regulation of glycogen turnover
rationale: Members concern glucagon/PKA signalling, glucokinase regulation and control of glycogen synthesis and breakdown; glucokinase and glycogenolysis terms distinguish it from glucose-6-phosphatase/glycogen storage and gluconeogenesis confusables.

core: Organic cation and anion transmembrane transport
qualifier: of xenobiotics and flavonoids
name: Organic cation and anion transport of xenobiotics and flavonoids
rationale: Members are organic cation/anion and xenobiotic transport including alpha-ketoglutarate exchange, glycoside and flavone handling and ciprofloxacin disposition; organic cation and flavonoid/glycoside terms separate it from the SLCO/hepatic drug ADME and polyamine transport confusables.

qualifier: with IL-1, IL-37 and CD40 receptor signaling
name: Regulation of TLR, IL-1 and CD40 receptor signaling
rationale: Members regulate TLR (MyD88, TLR3, TLR4), IL-1/IL-37 and CD40 receptor signaling; receptor-level regulation distinguishes it from confusables centred on downstream TRIF/IKK/TAK1 events and inflammatory cytokine production.

qualifier: with cAMP attenuation
name: Muscarinic acetylcholine signaling and cAMP attenuation
rationale: Members are muscarinic (Gi- and PLC-coupled) acetylcholine receptor signaling plus cAMP breakdown by PDE1 and negative regulation of cAMP/PKA; the muscarinic receptor terms separate it from serotonin, nicotinic and adrenergic confusables, and cAMP attenuation from generic adenylate cyclase regulation.

qualifier: with macrophage anti-inflammatory and pathogen-response signaling
name: Phagocyte NADPH oxidase burst and macrophage anti-inflammatory signaling
rationale: Members combine respiratory burst and superoxide regulation via NADPH oxidase with tissue macrophage programmes (CD163, FCGR3A-driven IL-10) and phagocyte responses to anthrax toxin and Leishmania; the macrophage anti-inflammatory and pathogen terms distinguish it from neutrophil killing and hydrogen peroxide/ROS confusables.

qualifier: thyroid hormone and retinoic acid receptors, with quiescence transitions
name: Thyroid hormone and retinoid receptor transcription and quiescence control
rationale: Members concern thyroid hormone, retinoic acid and estrogen receptor signaling regulation, nuclear receptor transcription and SUMOylation, together with G0/G1 transitions; thyroid/retinoid receptor terms distinguish it from the sex steroid confusable, and nuclear receptor terms from the FOXO/morphogen quiescence confusables.

qualifier: via transferrin and heme scavenging
name: Iron uptake via transferrin and heme scavenging
rationale: Members cover transferrin endocytosis, DMT1/ferroportin iron transport and its defects, heme scavenging and transport, and systemic iron homeostasis; transferrin and heme terms distinguish it from oxygen/selenium/cadmium and copper/manganese confusables.

qualifier: integrin-mediated, by diapedesis
name: Integrin-mediated leukocyte extravasation and diapedesis
rationale: Members are integrin-mediated leukocyte migration and adhesion, diapedesis and T cell/neutrophil extravasation; extravasation and integrin terms distinguish it from chemokine/chemotaxis, endothelial adhesion-molecule and PECAM/integrin-activation confusables.

qualifier: from pregnenolone, with steroidogenic enzyme deficiencies
name: Corticosteroid biosynthesis from pregnenolone and its enzyme deficiencies
rationale: Members are pregnenolone, glucocorticoid and mineralocorticoid synthesis, the adrenodoxin electron transport supplying mitochondrial CYPs, and CYP11A1/11B1/11B2/17A1/21A2 deficiencies; pregnenolone and electron transport terms separate it from corticosteroid-secretion regulation confusables, and corticosteroid terms from androgen/estrogen synthesis confusables.

qualifier: with platelet formation and RUNX1 control
name: Megakaryocyte-erythroid differentiation and platelet formation
rationale: Members cover megakaryocyte development and its regulation, platelet morphogenesis, RUNX1 control of megakaryocyte genes, erythroid-megakaryocytic and terminal erythroid programmes and erythrocyte differentiation regulation; megakaryocyte/platelet terms distinguish it from general RUNX1, myeloid progenitor/granulopoiesis and late-erythroid confusables.

qualifier: fear, CRH and corticosterone, and ethanol drinking
name: Behavioral stress, fear and ethanol drinking responses
rationale: Members are behavioral and hormonal (CRH, corticosterone) responses to stress, fear and immobilization plus ethanol-related and drinking behavior; this distinguishes it from glucocorticoid/ACTH secretion confusables, social/mating behavior and neuropeptide signaling confusables.

core: Cardiac calcium release and contractility control
qualifier: dampening of contraction and heart rate
name: Cardiac calcium release and dampening of contraction and heart rate
rationale: Members concern sarcoplasmic calcium release regulating cardiac contraction and relaxation, cardiomyocyte membrane potential and ion homeostasis, with negative regulation of contraction and heart rate; the negative regulation terms separate it from the positive inotropy/chronotropy confusable, cardiac setting from the skeletal muscle one, and calcium release from the conduction/gap junction one.

qualifier: in hepatocyte proliferation and liver regeneration
name: HGF-MET signaling in hepatocyte proliferation and liver regeneration
rationale: Members are MET receptor activation and downstream effectors, HGF/MST1 responses, plus hepatocyte proliferation and differentiation, liver morphogenesis and regeneration; MET and liver terms distinguish it from PTK6, generic PI3K/RTK, TGF-beta and erythropoietin/IGF1R confusables.

qualifier: EPO, TPO and FLT3 to STAT5, with CBL attenuation
name: EPO, TPO and FLT3 receptor signaling to STAT5
rationale: Members are erythropoietin, thrombopoietin and FLT3 (including oncogenic ITD/fusion and CBL-mutant) signaling to STAT5, PI3K, RAS and PLCG and its negative regulation, plus G-CSF inactivation and FGFR1 fusion signaling; EPO/TPO terms separate it from FLT3 drug-resistance and IL-3/IL-5 confusables, and FLT3/STAT5 from the PDGFR/ALK/FGFR oncogenic confusables.

qualifier: with dietary hexose uptake, fructose catabolism and inherited disorders
name: Hexose uptake, fructose and glycogen metabolism with inherited disorders
rationale: Members cover intestinal digestion and absorption of sugars, hexose transporters, fructose catabolism, glycogen synthesis and breakdown, gluconeogenesis and many inherited defects of these; hexose uptake and glycogen storage disease terms separate it from pentose/galactose Leloir and glucagon/fructose 2,6-bisphosphate confusables.

qualifier: with cell water homeostasis and renal salt transport
name: Osmotic and salt stress responses and cell water homeostasis
rationale: Members are hyper- and hypo-osmotic and salt stress responses, osmosensory signaling, intracellular water homeostasis and renal sodium/transepithelial chloride transport; osmosensing terms distinguish it from cation-chloride cotransporter, potassium and aldosterone/sodium transport confusables.

qualifier: of KIT and PDGFR mutants
name: Tyrosine kinase inhibitor resistance of KIT and PDGFR mutants
rationale: Every member describes KIT or PDGFR mutants binding or resisting kinase inhibitors; the KIT/PDGFR drug-resistance focus separates it from FLT3/ALK resistance confusables and from KIT oncogenic signaling confusables.

qualifier: with iron-sulfur cluster assembly
name: Heme biosynthesis and iron-sulfur cluster assembly
rationale: Members cover heme A/B and protoporphyrinogen synthesis and its regulation together with mitochondrial and cytosolic iron-sulfur cluster assembly and TCA enzyme maturation; this separates it from iron uptake/transport, oxidative phosphorylation, erythrocyte gas transport and steroidogenic confusables.
